subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

The river __overflew its banks__ and flooded the village.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'overflowed its banks.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in Part (overflew its banks) of the sentence.
 
• As per instructions, the remaining portion of the sentence is correct and from the verb, **'flooded'** (past form) we can deduct the sentence is in the simple past tense.
 
• In the erroneous part the verb **'overflew' **is in past participle (V3) form.
 
• The structure of sentences in Simple past tense is:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + object.
 
 
 
• So we will replace the V3 **'overflew' **with V2 **'overflow.'**
 
• Therefore, the use of 'overflew its banks' in the sentence should be replaced with 'overflowed its banks' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence:__ The river __overflowed its banks__ and flooded the village.
